## Monster Hunter Outlanders (Tencent) Cheats — iOS Mod Menu

**Target Bundle ID:** `com.tencent.mhadv`  
**Architecture:** `arm64` (Rootless) & `arm64e` (RootHide)

---

### ⚔️ Tab 1 — Combat
- **God Mode (No Damage)** — Multi-offset hex patch + damage result zeroing hook (`0x4631298`, `0x4631508`, `0x4632EC0`)
- **1-Hit Kill Monsters** — Instant monster elimination hex patch (`0x465EC14`)
- **Damage Multiplier (`1x – 50x`)** — Scales physical & elemental hit damage (`0x465E9A0`)
- **Effective ATK Boost (`1x – 20x`)** — Multiplies hunter effective attack rating (`0x4637690`)

### 🐉 Tab 2 — Enemy
- **Instant Part Break** — Forces `999,999` part break damage on hit (`0x465BA60`)
- **Freeze Monster HP** — Locks monster HP change during combat (`0x465E9A0`)

---

### 🛡️ Protection & Cloud Auto-Update
- **Cloud + On-Device Auto-Offset Engine** — Automatically resolves updated offsets across game updates without waiting for a new `.deb`
- **1-User License System** — Hardware UDID / Keychain device token binding via Hunter's license server
- **Glass UI Floating Mod Menu** — Draggable floating button, multi-tab layout, live sliders & persistent settings

**v1.0.9**
- Initial release for Monster Hunter Outlanders Tencent (`com.tencent.mhadv`)
- Added 1-User Device Token Lock, Cloud Auto-Update & Rootless/RootHide support
